verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a personal AI agent, since comparable agents in the category can be run on a user's own infrastructure, so the axis applies. Instinct's evidence describes only a vendor-run, invite-only service, accessed by text or call or through Mac OS and mobile apps. User data is indexed and stored on the vendor side, and the public surface exposes no downloadable server, repository, or self-host deployment option.
